closed_this_round.previous: Data tables 08025f00 / 08025f08 / 08025ee8 contents were unread; their consumers and the role of the neighbouring tables were unknown.
closed_this_round.now: They are three of five 8-byte permutations of 0..7 (three distinct maps R/S/T), consumed through config slot +0x1a4. The neighbouring 0x08025ec0 mask table, 0x08025ed0 / 0x08025f10 peripheral address tables, 0x08025f28 tail array and 0x0802420c u16 divisor table are all decoded. All nine pointer references are exact full-image hit sets. The previous round's byte/offset note was found to be wrong and is corrected by a fresh dump.

closed_this_round.previous: The 0x18c byte cleared by K90 had no known reader or semantics; every 0xc6 immediate in the image was being treated as this slot.
closed_this_round.now: 0x18c is built only by movs #0xc6; lsls #1 at three sites: 0800f744 (writes 1 to the global 0x2000a4c0 object with DSB/DMB/SEV), 0800fd3a (K90 clears the config object byte) and 0801e68a (main dispatcher reads it). It is copied to report +0x3a80, the adjacent +0x18d byte goes to +0x3a81, and 0xff is a sentinel branching to 0801ea3e. lsls #2 (0x318) and lsls #5 (0x18c0) sites are different slots.

closed_this_round.previous: Which callback/timeout slots the 14 setters write was only a loose list; +0x1a4 and +0x1a0 had no role.
closed_this_round.now: A 14-row slot ledger is derived from the pass2 setter exports with derived-base offsets (adds rN,#0xfc) correctly accumulated. +0x1a0 and +0x1a4 are pointers to 8-byte tables copied into the report when non-NULL; +0x1a4 has three writers selected by hwrev / sku / devicesn. High slots are attributed to consumers in 0801d888 (+0x114 block copy, +0x188 bounded count, +0x190 side callback, +0x194 post-init callback, +0x19c report field). The 1000ms timeout is assembled by the dispatcher into the report object, not stored as a standalone config slot.

closed_this_round.previous: 0800e8b4 USART baud-rate register values were not recomputed from 64MHz; the 08008174 division semantics were only inferred from call sites.
closed_this_round.now: 08008174 is confirmed at instruction level as unsigned division (quotient r0 / remainder r1). Both BRR paths are reproduced: path A writes (clock//divisor + baud/2)//baud verbatim; path B doubles that quotient and encodes a 3-bit fraction as (N & 0xfff0) | ((N & 0xf) >> 1). Range check is 0x10..0xffff with failure return 1. 256 parameterised cases plus worked examples (64MHz/115200 -> 0x22c / 0x453; 16MHz/115200 -> 0x8b / 0x113) show the RCC clock-source branch changes BRR by 4x. No standard baud-rate constant exists anywhere in the image, so all baud values are explicit model assumptions.
